title: Remove “Shop Our Products” copy from the storefront

requirements.text: Remove the customer-facing text “Shop Our Products” from the storefront UI, while keeping the product grid and shopping flow intact.
acceptanceCriteria: On the storefront page, the section heading that currently reads “Shop Our Products” is no longer shown to customers.
The product listing/grid still renders as before and remains accessible on the storefront page.
No other customer-facing location shows the exact text “Shop Our Products”.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not remove the ability for customers to browse products or add items to the cart.
Do not change backend product APIs or data models.
